Name: Latvian Learner Corpus (LaVa)
Description:
The corpus includes almost 1,000 texts written by foreign students at a Latvian higher education institution.
The students are learning Latvian as a foreign language in their first or second semester. The morphologically annotated texts have been checked manually, and language learners' errors have been manually annotated.
The corpus is available for online querying through the LaVa search interface and the noSketch Engine concordancer.
